subject: CSC 240 Data Structures
reviews: Hardest workload of any CS class I've taken, but it got me ready for my internship interviews.
The weekly labs take 6 to 8 hours. Worth it though, everything later builds on this.
Very useful course. Start every lab the day it's posted or you will fall behind.
Too much work for one class. I was up late every Thursday finishing labs.
You actually learn how to write efficient code here. Heavy, but valuable.

subject: PSY 101 Introduction to Psychology
reviews: Easy A if you do the readings. The topics were genuinely interesting.
Fun class, light workload, and the videos in lecture kept it engaging.
Really enjoyed it. Quizzes are straightforward and the material is interesting.
Great gen ed. Not much work and I learned a lot about how people think.

subject: BUS 210 Business Communication
reviews: Very disorganized. The syllabus changed three times and nobody knew what was due.
Grading felt random and feedback came back weeks late, if at all.
Assignments were posted late and the instructions contradicted each other.
Boring lectures and no clear structure. I would not take this section again.

subject: Professor Diane Morales
reviews: Explains everything clearly and checks that the room is following before moving on.
Answers emails within a few hours, even on weekends.
Exams were fair and matched exactly what we covered in class.
Clear lectures, very patient in office hours. Would take again.
One of the best on campus. Organized, clear, and always available.

subject: Professor Gary Lindqvist
reviews: Extremely harsh grader. Points off for things that were never in the rubric.
Expectations are never explained, then you lose points for not meeting them.
Dismissive when students ask questions in class.
Avoid if you can. Grading is strict and the assignment instructions are vague.

subject: Professor Alan Brightwater
reviews: Best professor I've had. Passionate and makes the material come alive.
Loved his enthusiasm. I learned more here than in any other class.
Lectures go way too fast and he rarely stops for questions.
Hard to keep up. Moves through slides so quickly that I gave up taking notes.

subject: CHM 152 General Chemistry II
reviews: The labs are great, hands-on and actually help the lectures make sense.
Lab reports are tedious and take longer than the lab itself.
Exams are hard. Do every practice problem.
Enjoyed the hands-on lab work, hated writing the reports.

subject: HIS 103 United States History (Online)
reviews: Fully online and self-paced, perfect for my work schedule.
Flexible deadlines and the weekly quizzes are easy if you watch the videos.
Great option if you commute. Everything is online and well organized.
Could do the work at my own pace. Would recommend.

subject: Professor Rajesh Iyer
reviews: Clearly an expert, he knows the field inside out. His accent is a little thick at first.
Very knowledgeable and always willing to stay after class to help.
Lectures can be hard to follow because he jumps between topics.
Knows so much, but explanations sometimes skip steps and the pacing is uneven.

subject: MTH 129 Precalculus
reviews: Easiest math class I've taken. Mostly review from high school.
So hard. I failed the first exam and had to drop.
Pretty easy if you remember algebra.
Way harder than people say. The exams are nothing like the homework.

subject: Professor Jordan Ellis
reviews: Best professor ever, so helpful!
Amazing. She made statistics make sense.
Take his class, you won't regret it.
Super helpful and kind.
Loved this class.

subject: MKT 300 Principles of Marketing
reviews: The group project is most of the grade, and my group did nothing.
Presentations every other week. Stressful but I got better at public speaking.
Learned real teamwork skills, even if the group work was frustrating.
Group members who don't show up drag your grade down.

subject: Professor Karen Whitfield
reviews: Grades come back weeks late, so you never know where you stand.
Reads directly off the slides for the whole class.
No feedback on papers, just a number.
Slow grading and the lectures are just the slides read aloud.

subject: MTH 150 Calculus I
reviews: Hard class, but the tutoring center in the library saved me.
Difficult exams. Go to tutoring early, not the week before the final.
The online homework every week keeps you on track.
Challenging but fair if you put in the time.

subject: Professor Lena Hoffmann
reviews: Weekly quizzes are 10 questions and she drops your lowest 2.
Fair grading. Dropping the 2 lowest quizzes really helps.
Quizzes are short and match the reading.
Very organized, the quiz policy is clear from day one.

subject: FYE 101 First Year Experience
reviews: Waste of time. Nothing I didn't already know.
Pointless busywork every week.
Didn't learn anything useful.
Felt like a requirement for the sake of a requirement.
